scientific_integrity: Analytical global proof and Poisson central limit theorem; accompanying numerical tests are diagnostic, not an exhaustive certificate. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Independent Poisson receipt, common habitat quality, hard initial quorum, continuous expected founder effort, and an expected-count objective. No long-term population persistence or empirical field calibration is asserted. Two-founder activation laws were already known and are not claimed as new; earlier generic sigmoid-allocation results cover the equal-support baseline. Historical priority for uninspected early optimization papers remains provisional.
title: Consecutive habitat-activation thresholds for Poisson founder quorums
